from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u013/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    border = next(v for row in grid for v in row if any(v != row[0] for row in grid))
    # Identify the non-background outline color, then fill bounded background regions.
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    outline=next(v for v in counts if v != bg)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] != bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; outside=False
        while q:
          y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
          if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: outside=True
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==bg:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        if not outside:
          for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=4
    return out
'''
